open_points.subject: start-up recovery after an unknown outcome was resolved not_applied
open_points.text: “an attempt the owner resolved concludes from its records and is not reached again (A11 rule 3)”
open_points.question: After a crash commits an unknown attempt’s resolution as `not_applied` but occurs before the same request creates the required fresh approval, must recovery reach the element to create that approval, or leave it unreached with no approval the owner can decide?
options: Reach an attempt resolved `not_applied` and create the fresh approval; do not reach attempts resolved `applied`.
Never reach any resolved attempt and derive an `owner_approval` wait without an EffectApproval.
Treat the resolution and creation of the fresh approval as one atomic store change.
open_points.default_guess: Reach an attempt resolved `not_applied` during recovery to create the fresh approval, while treating an attempt resolved `applied` as concluded without reaching it again.
